skins.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production transparent 3D mascot for the existing Shark SOS mobile game.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and absolute reference for pose, camera, proportions, facial identity, orange-white life ring, lighting, and composition. Input image 2 is ONLY the supporting reference for this skin's colors and costume, NOT for its sideways swimming pose.
Create exactly ONE square RGBA image: the SAME happy round baby shark of image 1 popping upright through the SAME glossy orange-and-ivory striped life ring. Preserve its large open smiling mouth, little rounded teeth, blue eyes, ivory muzzle and belly, two outstretched pectoral fins, dorsal fin behind head, and ONE tail curving up behind on viewer's right. Keep frontal three-quarter view, no side-on swimming pose. Change ONLY the shark's skin colors and integrated theme decorations as specified below. Do not recolor, replace, decorate or distort the life ring. Keep the ring's relative size, position and perspective consistent with image 1.
Polished soft toy-like 3D shading, upper-left soft light, clear silhouette. Entire shark including tail, fin, ornaments AND ring within frame, centered, about 6 percent true transparent margin on all sides, no clipping. True transparent background including spaces between fins, tail and ring. No scenery, sea, water, shadows on floor, extra characters, text, watermark, grid, checkerboard, collage or image border.
THEME: Cherry blossom: blush pink shark back and fins, raspberry edges, ivory muzzle and belly. Sculpted pale pink sakura flower cluster with golden stamens, small green leaves and raspberry ribbon at dorsal base, a few petal shaped markings. Match image 2 costume.
